reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 36 original B1/B2 adjective questions: checked every complete German sentence, inflection, all four options per variant, accepted answer, bilingual feedback and distinct contexts. Corrected vertraglich gloss from 'compatible' to contractual; contrasted vermutlich and voraussichtlich, völlig and vollständig. Deferred specialized vermögenswirksam and malformed standalone vorder for human review. No inherited examples copied. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval pending.
